# CodeRabbit findings for PAN-5281 (PR #5299)

CodeRabbit posted 3 inline finding(s). CodeRabbit is advisory: nothing waits for these,
but each one gets an answer, either a fix or a reply with your reason.

- Thread 4575574042 · src/lib/git/__tests__/attributed-commits.test.ts:41 [Minor]: Disable commit signing in the fixture Git helper.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5299#discussion_r4575574042
- Thread 4575574053 · src/lib/git/attributed-commits.ts:91 [Minor]: Make the prefilter accept equivalent trailer keys.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5299#discussion_r4575574053
- Thread 4575574057 · src/lib/launcher-git-guard.ts:353 [Minor]: Override the missing-trailer policy for attribution.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5299#discussion_r4575574057

## What to do

1. Read each thread (open its link, or the code at the path and line).
2. If you agree with a finding, fix it.
3. If you reject a finding, reply on its thread with your reason:
   `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/pulls/5299/comments/<thread id>/replies -f body="<reason>"`
4. If you changed code: run the quality gates on what you touched, commit, push, then run `pan review request PAN-5281 -m "CodeRabbit <thread ids>: <what you changed>"`.
   If you only replied, you are done.
5. If PR #5299 has already merged when you read this, stop: after the merge Overdeck files a follow-up issue
   for every thread with no reply, no later commit to its file, and no re-review request naming its thread id.
